name: 📖 README — SmartLab Node-RED Dashboard
info:
# SmartLab Asset Borrowing — Node-RED Monitoring Dashboard

## Versi
- Node-RED: 5.0.0
- Dashboard: @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard v1.30.2 (Dashboard 2.0)

## Flows
0. **Auto Login** — Login otomatis ke backend, simpan JWT di global context
1. **MQTT Event Monitor** — Subscribe smartlab/events, tampilkan BORROW_CREATED & RETURN_CONFIRMED
2. **Heartbeat & Device Status** — Subscribe smartlab/heartbeat, monitor ESP32-S3 online/offline
3. **Stats Polling** — Poll GET /api/stats/overview setiap 10 detik, tampilkan gauge & text
4. **Activity Feed** — Poll GET /api/stats/activity?limit=10 setiap 15 detik, tampilkan tabel
5. **Manual Admin Actions** — Tombol Refresh Stats untuk trigger manual

## Setup
1. Pastikan MQTT broker berjalan di localhost:1883
2. Pastikan backend API berjalan di http://127.0.0.1:3001
3. Import file ini ke Node-RED via menu → Import → Clipboard
4. Deploy dan buka Dashboard di http://localhost:1880/dashboard
